district: City and County of San Francisco
summary: A Yes vote changes the city's required contributions to its affordable housing fund.

housing.text: The Yes on Measure C campaign supports renewing and expanding dedicated funding to build and preserve affordable housing in San Francisco.
housing.quote: Renews funding to build and preserve affordable homes in San Francisco — with no new taxes.

housing.text: The No position opposes increasing the City’s annual Housing Trust Fund contribution and expanding affordable-housing programs.
housing.quote: If you vote NO, you do not want to make these changes.
